column1: # Methods a mod overrides with the 1.20.1 signature that 1.21.1 never calls (see Mc1201Migration): the class gets the 1.21.1-shaped method, which calls the mod's.
# owner TAB old name TAB old descriptor TAB new name TAB new descriptor TAB argument map TAB result adapter TAB remember
# owner: the Minecraft class that declares the new method (the mod class must inherit from it, or from a class we cannot see).
# argument map: - (the old parameters are the first new ones) or one entry per old parameter: an index into the new parameters, "this", "null", or
#   Class.method@index (static helper in the migrate package taking that new parameter and returning the old parameter's type).
# result adapter: - (same type, or discarded for a void new method), Class.method (static, old result to new result), or arg:N (return new parameter N).
# remember: index of the new parameter handed to MigrateContext.remember first (the registry provider, the entity data builder), or -.
# A call of the old method that resolves to Minecraft's own implementation (super.load(tag)) gets the missing provider/builder argument from MigrateContext.
# --- ATM 9 run: ParticleType.codec() was a Codec, is a MapCodec now, and the stream codec is new (built from the old codec)
